existing_mixed_model_scope.reason_preserved: This existing scope compares exact Eco-G 120 manual configurations under one established completeness and evidence contract. The review preserves it and does not generalize its comparability to other models or scopes.

design_options.name: Scope-Preserving Model Navigation
design_options.description: Show five model-family summaries and a directory of nineteen existing reporting scopes. Launch comparison only inside an existing scope; preserve the one established Sandero/Stepway mixed scope.

design_options.name: Global Common-Attribute Matrix
design_options.description: Intersect attributes across all models and show one broad technical matrix.
design_options.rejection_reason: Attribute presence alone does not establish comparable measurement context, fuel, gear, cargo state, source date or reporting denominator.

design_options.name: Unrestricted Cross-Model Pairing
design_options.description: Allow any two of the seventy-two configurations to be compared directly.
design_options.rejection_reason: This would bypass the nineteen explicit completeness/evidence scopes and create unsupported cross-scope pair semantics.

design_options.name: Normalized Model Ranking
design_options.description: Convert model characteristics into scores or recommendations.
design_options.rejection_reason: The repository stores evidence, not consumer preference weights, and the release contract prohibits ranking and recommendation generation.

selection.name: Scope-Preserving Model Navigation
selection.required_unknown_handling: A missing model-level fact remains not stated. Empty recorded-seat sets for Bigster and Duster must not be rendered as zero seats or an assumed five-seat value.
selection.pair_generation_rule: Generate or open pairs only from an existing reporting scope. Never synthesize a pair from model-card membership.
selection.mixed_scope_rule: Label sandero_ecog120_manual explicitly as a shared Sandero and Sandero Stepway scope and preserve its existing five configurations and ten pairs without expanding it.

acceptance_criteria: Every active configuration appears once in the scope directory.
All five model families show exact configuration and price-coverage counts.
All nineteen scopes are linked without generating a new pair.
The shared Sandero/Stepway manual scope is visibly marked as mixed-model.
Bigster and Duster seat summaries remain not stated until exact seat observations exist.
No score, winner, recommendation, inferred value or cross-scope pair is emitted.
JSON and HTML are deterministic and fully usable offline.

next_package.name: Cross-Model Comparison View Foundation
next_package.goal: Implement a deterministic JSON and standalone HTML navigation view over five model families and nineteen existing scopes, preserving the established Sandero/Stepway mixed scope and generating no new comparison pair or inferred value.
